name: Colin Zumbro
bio:
Atramentum is a premier tattoo studio nestled in the heart of Witten, Germany, where master artist Colin Zumbro specializes in the mesmerizing intricacy of tribal and geometric designs. With an upcoming guest spot in Dublin, from November 22nd to 26th, Atramentum offers both locals and international clientele the opportunity to adorn their skin with unique, bold patterns. To book an appointment, reach out to info@atramentum-tattoo.com and experience the fusion of ancient artistry and modern precision.
